## System Overview

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span><span>system info</span><span>dashboard</span></div>

One-glance dashboard: OS, host, kernel, uptime, CPU usage, memory, swap, load average and disks.

```sh
dogubako system overview
```

Id `system.overview` · MCP `system_overview` · Output: structured data · Timeout 1 min

Also found by: system, overview, dashboard, cpu, memory, ram, uptime, disk, host

This tool has no options.

## CPU Info

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span><span>system info</span><span>dashboard</span></div>

CPU brand, vendor, physical/logical cores, per-core usage (sampled ~300 ms), frequencies and instruction-set features.

```sh

```

Id `system.cpu` · MCP `system_cpu` · Output: structured data · Timeout 1 min

Also found by: cpu, processor, cores, threads, usage, frequency, avx, neon

## Top Processes

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span><span>process list</span><span>dashboard</span></div>

Top running processes by CPU or memory with PID, user, status and start time (command lines only on request).

```sh
dogubako system processes [options]
```

Id `system.processes` · MCP `system_processes` · Output: structured data · Timeout 1 min

Also found by: process, task manager, top, htop, cpu hog, memory usage, running programs, pid

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sort_by` | `--sort-by` | choice | `cpu` | One of: `cpu` (CPU usage), `memory`, `name`, `pid`, `start` (Newest first). |
| `limit` | `--limit` | integer 1–500 | `25` | Number of processes. |
| `filter` | `--filter` | text |  | Name contains. |
| `include_command` | `--include-command` | boolean | `false` | Include full command lines (may contain secrets). *Advanced.* |
